about: Where the studio finds its assets. base.production is the R2 bucket zacess-media served at https://media.zacess.com; base.development is the local tree that scripts/studio-assets.mjs writes into public/studio-assets. A build uses production, astro dev uses development and PUBLIC_STUDIO_BASE overrides both. Paths in layout are relative to the base. The script fills available, catalogue, recording and generated.

scenes.description: Fish of three sizes, bubbles, seaweed, a boat on the surface and an occasional whale, under a daylit sky in light themes
Rain on a lamplit evening street with puddles, a walker under an umbrella and distant lightning, an overcast afternoon in light themes
Flakes at three depths drifting over far hills and pines, settling into a bank along the bottom, by day in light themes
Twinkling stars over a faint band of the galaxy and low hills, a crescent moon and a slow shooting star, at dawn in light themes
Falling columns of characters in the theme's syntax colours, each with a bright head, over a softly shaded backdrop

Striped hot air balloons lifting slowly from behind rolling hills under soft drifting clouds, at dawn or by day in light themes

A painted mug of tea with curling steam beside books and a plant, with weather at the window

A flower bed by a picket fence that sprouts, grows and blooms over a couple of minutes, with butterflies, before it starts again
A grid of painted folded pages in the theme's colours, one tile changing at a time
Broad ribbons of shaded silk twisting and flowing slowly across the screen
Rows of sunflowers swaying under a warm sky, with bees drifting between the heads
Mountains and pines mirrored in a still lake at sunrise, with mist on the water, a slow ripple and a heron fishing

Folded paper boats drifting down a stream past swaying reeds, the current carrying them on
A row of windmills turning slowly over a patchwork of fields as clouds pass overhead

A circuit board on a lamp-lit bench lighting its LEDs in turn until the status LED glows green, by day in light themes
Slanting rain under rolling banks of storm cloud, a tree in full leaf bending in the wind and lightning, by day in light themes

Riveted steel plates where rust creeps out from the rivets, flakes and runs down in streaks
